notes: Planning-only Dallas County source candidates. All sources default to inactive and should_ingest=false. No source should be promoted until dry-run parsing, evidence preservation, duplicate checks, freshness rules, and repair behavior are validated.

tiers.tier_3: Manual review, third-party, or future sources.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Tax Office Sheriff Sales
candidates.freshness_rule: Monthly sheriff sale cycle; verify current auction page before outreach.
candidates.verification_path: Open Dallas County Tax Office Sheriff Sales, then linked auction portal, and confirm address, parcel, case, amount, and sale date.
candidates.risk_limitations: Portal may require registration, session, or human verification. No login automation, bidding automation, or CAPTCHA bypass.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Clerk Foreclosure Notices
candidates.freshness_rule: Monthly foreclosure notice cycle; verify notice PDF or public search result before outreach.
candidates.verification_path: Open county foreclosure notice PDF or Dallas Public Search foreclosure result and confirm property address and sale date.
candidates.risk_limitations: PDF formats vary and legal descriptions may lack clean situs addresses. Newer notices may require public search portal review.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Public Works Tax Foreclosure Resales
candidates.freshness_rule: Use current struck-off list or sale posting date; verify sealed-bid instructions before action.
candidates.verification_path: Open Public Works property division page, struck-off list, and related DCAD/Courts Portal links.
candidates.risk_limitations: Inventory may be attachment-based and not a direct motivated seller list. Treat as acquisition inventory or title/evidence support.

candidates.source_name: Dallas OpenData Code Violations
candidates.freshness_rule: Use Socrata row update metadata when available; otherwise use captured_at.
candidates.verification_path: Open Dallas OpenData row and verify address, case type, and active/open status.
candidates.risk_limitations: Existing registry references n7km-yvgf while prior planning references x9pz-kdq9. Reconcile current dataset ID and schema before promotion.

candidates.source_name: Dallas Central Appraisal District Property Search
candidates.freshness_rule: Use annual appraisal year and property detail capture date.
candidates.verification_path: Search by address or account, open DCAD detail, confirm owner, account, legal description, and situs address.
candidates.risk_limitations: Assessed value is not ARV. Use for verification and appraisal context only.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Clerk Official Public Records / Public Search
candidates.freshness_rule: Recording-driven. Verify foreclosure notices and liens close to action date.
candidates.verification_path: Open Dallas Public Search, choose Foreclosure or UCC/Deeds, and confirm instrument/document image.
candidates.risk_limitations: Portal/session behavior may limit automation. Texas non-disclosure limits official sale-price data.

candidates.source_name: DCAD GIS Data Products and Property Map
candidates.freshness_rule: Use DCAD current tax-year parcel file naming and download date.
candidates.verification_path: Download current DCAD GIS file or use property map, then join parcel/account to lead evidence.
candidates.risk_limitations: GIS data is approximate and informational. Requires file handling and schema validation before use.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County GIS and Open Data Hub
candidates.freshness_rule: Use ArcGIS item/layer update date where available.
candidates.verification_path: Open Dallas County GIS page, then referenced GIS Data Hub or NCTCOG/DCAD parcel source.
candidates.risk_limitations: County GIS page points parcel data to DCAD. Treat as support, not primary parcel authority.

candidates.source_name: Dallas OpenData Building Permits
candidates.freshness_rule: Use Socrata metadata and row timestamps; verify data-last-updated before use.
candidates.verification_path: Open dataset/API row and confirm permit number, address, permit type, and work description.
candidates.risk_limitations: Permits are enrichment only. Old permits or closed work do not prove seller motivation.

candidates.source_name: Dallas 311 Service Requests
candidates.freshness_rule: Use request created/closed dates if available.
candidates.verification_path: Open 311 request/status source and confirm property-level address and request type.
candidates.risk_limitations: Citizen service requests are noisy and support-only unless tied to property-level code/nuisance evidence.

candidates.source_name: City of Dallas Vacant Building Program
candidates.freshness_rule: Procedure page. Recheck before relying on fees or registration requirements.
candidates.verification_path: Use as support when another source indicates vacant-building evidence.
candidates.risk_limitations: No confirmed public property-level vacant-building list. Do not ingest from this page alone.

candidates.source_name: Dallas Fire-Rescue Active Incidents and Prevention
candidates.freshness_rule: Active incidents are live and volatile; seek durable fire/code record before lead creation.
candidates.verification_path: Confirm active incident, then find durable permit, code, inspection, or official fire record evidence.
candidates.risk_limitations: May omit exact property and can change quickly. Support-only without durable property-level evidence.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Probate Courts and Courts Portal
candidates.freshness_rule: Court filing driven. Verify current case status before action.
candidates.verification_path: Open Dallas Courts Portal case, confirm probate details, then join to DCAD/OPR property evidence.
candidates.risk_limitations: Probate alone is not property-level distress. Requires property join before becoming actionable.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Official and Legal Notices
candidates.freshness_rule: Daily/business-day postings. Use notice date and end date.
candidates.verification_path: Open official notice item and preserve title, date, and document reference.
candidates.risk_limitations: Broad notice page. Most rows are not acquisition leads.

candidates.source_name: Dallas County Unincorporated Area Development Permits
candidates.jurisdiction: Dallas County Department of Unincorporated Area Services
candidates.freshness_rule: Procedure page. Verify before use on unincorporated property.
candidates.verification_path: Use for unincorporated Dallas County property verification when another source provides the parcel/address.
candidates.risk_limitations: Limited county jurisdiction and no confirmed public property-level list.

candidates.source_name: Linebarger Dallas Tax Sale List
candidates.freshness_rule: Monthly sale cycle; must be matched to Dallas County official source before action.
candidates.verification_path: Compare third-party list row against Dallas County Sheriff Sales, Courts Portal, and DCAD.
candidates.risk_limitations: Third-party support only. Not authoritative unless confirmed against official county records.

candidates.source_name: Texas Public Notices / Daily Commercial Record Support
candidates.freshness_rule: Publication-driven. Verify against official county record before use.
candidates.verification_path: Use only for discovery, then confirm against Dallas County Clerk, Public Search, DCAD, or Courts Portal.
candidates.risk_limitations: May be paywalled, incomplete, or duplicative. Secondary evidence only.

candidates.source_name: Public Utility Shutoff / Vacancy-Adjacent Indicators
candidates.jurisdiction: City of Dallas or Dallas County where lawful public data exists
candidates.freshness_rule: No reliable property-level public shutoff source confirmed.
candidates.verification_path: Do not create utility-shutoff leads unless a lawful public property-level record is later identified and classified.
candidates.risk_limitations: Privacy and availability risk. Use 311/vacant/code/fire sources instead for public vacancy-adjacent support.

candidates.source_name: Zillow Dallas Property and Sold Search Support
candidates.freshness_rule: Use operator capture time. Reverify before offer.
candidates.verification_path: Operator opens targeted address/sold search, captures visible candidates, and accepts comps manually.
candidates.risk_limitations: Third-party and may require human verification. No CAPTCHA bypass, no loops, no final ARV without operator-reviewed comps.

candidates.source_name: Redfin Dallas Sold and Listing Support
candidates.freshness_rule: Use operator capture time. Reverify before offer.
candidates.verification_path: Operator opens targeted address/sold search and accepts comps manually.
candidates.risk_limitations: Third-party and may block automation. Active listings must be labeled market support, not sold comps.

candidates.source_name: Realtor.com Dallas Listing Support
candidates.freshness_rule: Use operator capture time. Reverify before offer.
candidates.verification_path: Operator opens targeted search and verifies candidates before use.
candidates.risk_limitations: Third-party. Active listings are not sold comps and cannot finalize ARV alone.

candidates.source_name: Google Maps / Street View Condition Support
candidates.freshness_rule: Use visible imagery date when available; otherwise treat as manually verified context.
candidates.verification_path: Operator opens property in Maps/Street View and records only visible condition observations.
candidates.risk_limitations: Imagery can be stale. Do not infer occupancy, ownership, or current damage beyond visible evidence.

sold_comp_workflow: Start from a verified Dallas lead with a real property address.
Open targeted Zillow, Redfin, and Realtor searches using full address, city, state, and ZIP when available.
Import visible candidates as unverified only.
Operator approves the best 3-5 comps after checking sold/list status, sqft, beds/baths, distance, condition, and date.
Label active listings as market support, not sold comps.
arv_rules: No ARV when fewer than 3 accepted comps exist.
Show preliminary ARV range only from accepted comp evidence.
Use DCAD values as appraisal context only, never as ARV.
mao_rules: MAO requires accepted ARV range, repair estimate, wholesale spread target, and source verification.
Show conservative, moderate, and aggressive scenarios only from entered evidence.
Do not finalize first offer or walkaway from third-party estimate widgets alone.
